# openmetadata_ml_model Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata ML model by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_ml_model" "churn" {
  fully_qualified_name = "mlflow.ChurnModel"
}

output "churn_model_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_ml_model.churn.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) ML model fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) ML model UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Algorithm used to train the model.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) ML model name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent ML model service.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
